commands.image: c=$(sed -n 's/^ *ORKEON_COMMIT: *//p' .github/workflows/image.yml); docker build --build-arg ORKEON_SOURCE_REF=$c --build-arg ORKEON_REFRESH=$c -t orkeon-workshop .devcontainer
docs_checks: v=$(sed -n 's/^ *DOCFX_VERSION: *//p' .github/workflows/docs.yml); T="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/docfx-$v"; { test -x "$T/docfx" || dotnet tool install docfx --version "$v" --tool-path "$T"; } && DOCFX="$T/docfx" bash scripts/build-docs-site.sh
commands.release_readiness: l=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/Orkeon/orkeon.git refs/heads/main | cut -f1); p=$(sed -n 's/^ *ORKEON_COMMIT: *//p' .github/workflows/image.yml); echo "Orkeon main ${l:-unresolved}, ORKEON_COMMIT $p"; test -n "$l" && test "$l" = "$p"

manual_checks.ci_replay: the steps of .github/workflows/checks.yml in a node:24-bookworm container started on tail -f /dev/null
docs: the relative links and anchors of every Markdown file, hidden folders included
manual_checks.release: bench lint and tests, the harness evals in strict mode and the templates' self-check green, and the image built green on the latest Orkeon main (a build the user asks for, D74)

docs_mirror.rule: a change to an English page is ported to its French page in the same change; a page added, moved or removed is added, moved or removed in both toc.yml files and both indexes

orkeon_pin.also: every other file naming the previous short hash (tests of the bench, READMEs, comments), the rules and the user documentation that state what Orkeon does

contrib.commit: one sentence of what changed, naming the decisions D<n> and the Orkeon commit when it moves
checklist: the change is recorded in the plan (section 13 for a decision, section 11.1 for progress)
English everywhere; the user documentation mirrored in French in the same change
no key on disk; new shell scripts added with their executable bit (git add --chmod=+x)
orkeon-bench lint and tests, and the harness evals in strict mode, green
the workshop migrated to the latest Orkeon main; the image built only when the user asks for it (D74)

channels.name: ghcr-image
channels.check: ghcr.io/orkeon/orkeon-workshop:<version> and :<major>.<minor> resolve (anonymous pull token from https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository:orkeon/orkeon-workshop:pull, then HEAD /v2/orkeon/orkeon-workshop/manifests/<version>)

channels.name: image-run
channels.check: jobs of the image.yml run on <tag> - all success (the build runs the evals in strict mode, the bench tests and the templates' self-check)

channels.name: docs-site
channels.check: https://orkeon.github.io/orkeon-workshop/ answers 200 (the site follows main, built by docs.yml, not by the tag)
